summary: No undocumented access to REAL_CONTENT was found: exactly one file (build_structural_manifest.py) reads it, and only to compute aggregate structural statistics that are the deliberately-permitted REAL_STRUCTURE_ONLY manifest. Physical separation between the synthetic generator, the three solvers, and hidden truth is intact (C1: no leakage). The CRITICAL integrity violations found in this audit (F001 fabricated synthetic-recovery results, F002 unsupported headline reachability figure, F003 mislabeled/incomplete CP_SAT solver, F009 non-existent HYBRID wiring) are NOT data-access/leakage violations -- they are internal-consistency and truth-in-reporting violations within the CODE and RESULT layers, which is arguably worse for a package about to be authorized for production freezing, since no real-data restriction would have caught them.
